rsi2.verdict: Held up: made money after costs, beat random entries by more than luck, and still did so in the later part of the history (after it was published, where known).

turtle.verdict: Beat random entries in the earlier years but not clearly in the later part of the history (after it was published, where known): the edge seems to have faded.

golden.verdict: Made money after costs, but not clearly better than random entries: could be luck.
